extraction_scope: Source-reviewed mechanism ontology from paper XML sections and figure captions; no figure-only numeric quantification was required for the final mechanism class.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Arenicin-1 variants were directly assayed for bacterial outer and cytoplasmic membrane permeabilization in E. coli ML35p; the paper concludes that a membranolytic mechanism was maintained, with reduced inner-membrane permeabilization for modified-symmetry variants.
direct_assay_types: E. coli ML35p outer membrane permeabilization assay
E. coli ML35p cytoplasmic membrane permeabilization assay
mechanism_claims.limitations: The local XML/caption supports assay direction and biological interpretation; exact curve values are figure-only and not required for the activity/database gate.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Structure-activity interpretation links altered strand symmetry, branching, cyclization, and residue substitutions to changes in antimicrobial potency, cytotoxicity, and membrane permeabilization without assigning a non-membrane molecular target.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Molecular dynamics and structure figures support scaffold interpretation but are not promoted to direct antimicrobial mechanism assays.
